versions.fenced-final: Candidate identified by worker_sha256. In normal_companion, original denotes the named comparison baseline and optimized denotes the candidate.

protocol.product: Normal local companion, 5 Hz capture feed and 2 Hz sample loop, warm on a separate clip, paired A/B and B/A on four recorded Wuthering Waves gameplay segments. Sampling may choose different frames. Timings end when the complete default review returns. Cloud and physical playback excluded. Render service P95 uses frames during sessions.
protocol.fixed_real: Ten six-frame contact sheets reconstructed from the unmodified capture feed. SHA-256 matches the original normal review input for every clip. Four gameplay clips and six official trailer clips. Same real pixels, chronological labels, prompt, 160-token budget, and full vocabulary verifier. Three-worker order rotates through all six permutations, with separate warmup. Times are wall time from prepared six-frame JPEG to final returned reply, including any retry. Invalid generations count in the all-attempts metric; both_strict_cited restricts both endpoints to fully parseable JSON with nonempty observation and citations. P95 is nearest rank.
protocol.detail_prompt: 六张连续截图按左上到右下从早到晚排列。请复盘可见变化，只输出 JSON 对象。在 scene 写 fighting、settled 或 unclear；在 observation 用两三句完整中文描述角色或镜头的变化、场景与界面里的可见证据；在 observed_frames 数组写出依据的帧号。看不清的内容请如实说明，不猜测剧情、名称或数值。
protocol.synthetic: Six short and six long six-frame fixtures plus twelve labelled image questions. The established generator, answer scoring, normal preprocessing, original model geometry and output limits are unchanged. Previous and final alternated within pairs.
protocol.pressure: Independent diagnostic uses the identical renderer and records IOKit samples when the worker selects its path. Final latency runs omit added GPU polling. Source samples are under pressure.
protocol.scope: Full text parity is measured on returned strings. A machine-readable cited JSON requires a recognized scene as well as a nonempty observation and list of cited frames. The separate product parser enforces evidence numbering and text length. Unchanged facts in these samples are not a guarantee on other images. Frame service is simulated rendering, not in-game FPS.
